pages.title: §lMaterial → Affix Mapping
pages.text: Here are the directed affixes and bonus effects for each material.$(br2)Place a material in the super smithing table slot 2 to boost the specific affix's probability.$(br2)§7(Certain materials grant a fixed probability for their affix.)

pages.title: §6Blaze Rod → Flame Brand
pages.text: §6Blaze Rods§r grant 40% fixed probability for Flame Brand. Max level 8.

pages.title: §2Poisonous Potato → Venom Brand
pages.text: §2Poisonous Potatoes§r grant 40% fixed probability for Venom Brand. Max level 8.

pages.title: §8Wither Rose → Wither Brand
pages.text: §8Wither Roses§r grant 35% fixed probability for Wither Brand. Max level 7.

pages.title: §fGhast Tear → Regeneration
pages.text: §fGhast Tears§r grant 30% fixed probability for Regeneration Mark. Max level 7.

pages.title: §6Magma Cream → Flame/Regen
pages.text: §6Magma Cream§r grants Flame Brand 25% and Regeneration Mark 10% fixed probability.

pages.title: §3Heart of the Sea → Tidal Surge
pages.text: §3Heart of the Sea§r grants 45% fixed probability for Tidal Surge. Max level 8.

pages.title: §3Prismarine Crystals → Tidal Surge
pages.text: §3Prismarine Crystals§r grant 25% fixed probability for Tidal Surge.

pages.title: §eGolden Apple → Strength Blessing
pages.text: §eGolden Apples§r grant 40% fixed probability for Strength Blessing. Max level 8.

pages.title: §eGolden Carrot → Strength Blessing
pages.text: §eGolden Carrots§r grant 30% fixed probability for Strength Blessing.

pages.title: §bSpectral Arrow → Sharpshooter
pages.text: §bSpectral Arrows§r grant 35% fixed probability for Sharpshooter. Max level 7.

pages.title: §fArrow → Piercing Spear/Sharpshooter
pages.text: §fArrows§r grant Piercing Spear 20% and Sharpshooter 15% fixed probability.

pages.title: §fWind Charge → Momentum
pages.text: §fWind Charges§r grant 35% fixed probability for Momentum. Max level 7.

pages.title: §eRabbit Foot → Momentum/Sharpshooter
pages.text: §eRabbit Feet§r grant Momentum and Sharpshooter each 20% fixed probability.

pages.title: §2Fermented Spider Eye → Venom/Wither
pages.text: §2Fermented Spider Eyes§r grant Venom Brand and Wither Brand each 25% fixed probability.

pages.title: §3Trident → Tidal Surge
pages.text: §3Tridents§r grant 40% fixed probability for Tidal Surge. Max level 8.

pages.title: §eCookie → Big Stomach
pages.text: §eCookies§r grant 35% fixed probability for Big Stomach.

pages.title: §5Ender Pearl → Energy Conversion
pages.text: §5Ender Pearls§r grant 25% fixed probability for Energy Conversion.

pages.title: §dDragon's Breath → Tidal/Momentum/Strength
pages.text: §dDragon's Breath§r grants Tidal Surge, Momentum, and Strength Blessing each 30% fixed probability. Total 90% → normalized to 100%. Max level 8.
